services.desc: Step aboard the all-new Duffy 23 Sun Cruiser-where every day on the water feels like a mini getaway. Whether you’re gliding through calm harbors, anchoring for a swim, reeling in the catch of the day, or firing up the BBQ with friends, the 23 Sun Cruiser is designed for effortless fun. With spacious seating, a built-in outdoor galley option, and the quiet power of advanced electric propulsion, you can cruise in total comfort, entertain with ease, and enjoy every moment under the sun. Relax, unwind, and make every outing your perfect day on the water. Introducing the all-new 23 Sun Cruiser-the latest evolution in Duffy Electric Boats.
